# Ghost Spec 0.1

The v0.1 header-block specification, frozen as emitted by ghost-writer
producers: category, title, summary, tags, by, timestamp, lifecycle, sources.

The spec deliberately kept `sources` as plain strings — structured citation
objects arrived with the v0.2 upgrade path.

Historical context for the upgrade rules applied to this bundle's
[OKF Bundle](../concepts/okf-bundle.md) page.
